expected_reasoning: Concrete non-speech events may be present, but generic impacts often require object/action binding and may support REPAIR or NO_GO rather than a forced audio-bearing question.
reviewer_task: Describe and count only the impacts that can be heard.
Do not infer a specific ingredient, recipe step, or outcome from generic impacts.
Judge whether vision fully substitutes for the action identity.
Check recurrence probes before deciding authoring eligibility.
scenario: An audio-only interval contains several short metallic impacts. Synchronized video later shows a utensil contacting cookware.
title: Generic utensil impacts
